Tell us what you're building

AI development company, UK-led, built in the Philippines

Digital delivery
with a team
you can trust

We’re Offshorly, a UK-led AI development company. For over 10 years we’ve been helping businesses build, grow and evolve their digital products with transparency at the heart of everything. Today that means dedicated AI development teams, AI automations and AI products for businesses in the UK and the US: trained AI engineers in the Philippines, with British account management, who build and run AI tools for your business. And we still build the websites, platforms and prototypes we always have.

Whether you need to validate an idea fast, deliver a project, or build a long-term capable team, we have an engagement model that fits.

AI Development Teams

Your dedicated AI development team

Trained AI engineers with the developers, designers, PMs and QA around them, embedded in your business to build and run your AI tools and automations.

  • Right Resource at the Right Time at the Right Cost
  • Trained BA/PM builds deep understanding of your business
  • Every developer trained and assessed on our AI workflows before they reach you
  • Predictable monthly cost. Full transparency. No surprises.
IDEAL FOR Businesses that need an AI development team now

AI Development Services

Custom AI, built and priced stage by stage.

From a free consultation and a fixed-price proof of concept to a working tool and the people who run it. One stage at a time, each costed before you commit.

  • Free consultation, then a proof of concept in three days at a fixed price
  • Every stage costed before it starts
  • Your code, your IP, your data
  • A named developer owns every output
IDEAL FOR Businesses that want AI built without hiring a team yet

AI Automation

One manual process, automated and kept accurate.

Start with the process that costs your team the most hours. We automate it on your own systems and data, then measure it after launch so it stays accurate.

  • One process first, then the next
  • Built on your systems and your data
  • Accuracy measured after launch, not assumed
  • Grows into a dedicated team when it earns it
IDEAL FOR Teams doing high-volume work by hand

Why Offshorly

Different in ways that matter to you.

Not the cheapest. Not the biggest. Ten years of honest answers and software that delivers.

Straight talk in a world of hype

We advise on projects honestly including when we’re not the right fit. No buzzwords. No overselling.

UK-led, Philippine-based

Experienced UK leadership with top-tier Filipino talent. The quality you expect, at a cost that makes sense.

AI-enabled from the inside out

AI is part of how our teams work. Our AI Excellence Team keeps your team efficient and delivery improving continuously.

Radically transparent

Full code access, regular demos, direct team communication. We take a warts-and-all approach so there are never surprises.

Inspired, not just transactional

We challenge assumptions, contribute ideas, and take ownership. Our teams think like product experts, not just developers for hire.

A team that gets stronger over time

The longer you work with us, the more context we carry. Long-term partnerships are how we do our best work.

The Bigger Picture

AI Excellence in our Process.
AI Across your Journey.

The way we think about AI runs through everything: how we work, what we build, and how we keep building it as your business changes.

1
in our process

More than tools. Playbooks and agents.

Every team uses AI tooling as standard, from Figma and Firefly to Copilot and Claude, for faster iteration without inflating cost. On top of that, three things shape how we deliver: a Pixel Perfection playbook for how design and development work together on smaller projects, a Development playbook for our build teams, and a growing set of skills agents that automate the repetitive parts of delivery.

The efficiency is yours.
